turns.query: Did the Southern station meet Hong Kong's 8-hour ozone Air Quality Objective in 2025? Give the number of days on which its daily maximum 8-hour ozone exceeded the objective's 160 ug/m3, and the tenth-highest of the year's daily maximum 8-hour values.

EPD's 2025 report says Southern met the eight-hour ozone objective: nine exceedance days and a tenth-highest value near 160 ug/m3. An earlier analysis found ten days. Reconcile the counts and advise what to publish.
